end.parentNote: Harsh practised using the x-direction first and then the y-direction to locate points. They explained horizontal and vertical directions, quadrants, and why (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different; this method worked in 2 of 3 attempts. A later question was left unanswered and was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to plot a few ordered pairs and name their quadrants on a small grid.
